title: WSDG: Make hyperlinks for doc and source references.
description:
Add two macros for creating links to files and directories within the Wireshark
source tree.

Use those to turn all references to files in "doc/" into corresponding
hyperlinks to those files in the master branch of our Gitlab repository.

Also use them to turn a handful of references to other files/directories into
corresponding hyperlinks, skipping a few where they relate to discussion of
release branches and where a link to the corresponding "master" file/directory
could be misleading.

AI-Assisted: no

notes.body: I'd like to think about these file references to the local clone the developer has made. Not opposed to the gitlab links, but the full path should be retained in the document, IMHO, so to guide the developer to the file in the local clone.

The change should retain all of the existing file paths in the text of the document, if that's what you're concerned about -- except in the one place I just spotted where I inadvertently dropped a backslash in the Windows instructions.  In fact, a few places will gain _extra_ path information in the text of the document where before it was missing (the section on `ColorUtils`) or out-of-date (the section on Debian packaging).

@@ -0,0 +1,56 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+require 'asciidoctor/extensions' unless RUBY_ENGINE == 'opal'
+
+include ::Asciidoctor
+
+# An inline macro that generates a link to a file in the 'master' branch of the
+# Wireshark repository.
+#
+# Usage
+#
+#   wsrepofile:<path>[<descriptive text>]
+#
+# The default is to use <path> as the descriptive text.
+#
+class WSRepoFileInlineMacro < Extensions::InlineMacroProcessor
+  include WsUtils
+  use_dsl
+
+  named :wsrepofile
+  parse_content_as :text
+
+  def process(parent, repopath, attrs)
+    if repopath[0] == '/'
+        repopath = repopath[1..]
+    end
+    target = %(https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/raw/master/#{repopath})
+    repotext = !attrs['text'].nil_or_empty? ? attrs['text'] : repopath
+    create_doc_links(parent, target, repotext)
+  end
+end
+
+# An inline macro that generates a link to a view of a directory in the
+# 'master' branch of the Wireshark repository.
+#
+# Usage
+#
+#   wsrepodir:<path>[<descriptive text>]
+#
+# The default is to use <path> as the descriptive text.
+#
+class WSRepoDirInlineMacro < Extensions::InlineMacroProcessor
+  include WsUtils
+  use_dsl
+
+  named :wsrepodir
+  parse_content_as :text
+
+  def process(parent, repopath, attrs)
+    if repopath[0] == '/'
+        repopath = repopath[1..]
+    end
+    target = %(https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/tree/master/#{repopath})
+    repotext = !attrs['text'].nil_or_empty? ? attrs['text'] : repopath
+    create_doc_links(parent, target, repotext)
+  end
+end
